name: Artemis Research
description: Quick sourced Brave lookups and deep cited multi-engine research via a supervised, long-lived Artemis MCP child.

pythonPath.description: Absolute path to the Python interpreter that runs the Artemis MCP server.

serverPath.description: Absolute path to the Artemis MCP server script (server.py).

artemisPath.description: Value for ARTEMIS_PATH (the artemis package root).

ollamaBaseUrl.description: LLM bridge URL passed to the child as OLLAMA_BASE_URL (not a credential).

checkpointDb.description: SQLite checkpoint store for this gateway's research runs (isolated from OpenCode's).

eagerStart.description: Start the child at plugin load instead of lazily on first use.
